what_happened: lean_run_code probe against the built tree: a val-preserving Beh.castLen plus a sum-form glueSum on top of Sheaf.glue, the PathHom structure, PathHom.ext', PathHom.id, a Mathlib Category instance on a one-object BObj D built from Duration.lean's Dur laws, the len functor with map_id/map_comp by rfl, and a general IsDiscreteConduche predicate all typecheck; glueSum measures [propext, Quot.sound]. De-risks the core encoding before planning.

C15 paper-anchor gate: def:conduche, def:path-category and fact:conduche-equivalence have NO rows in docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md (only cor:path-fibration and def:twisted-arrow do), so citing them in Path.lean's docstring fails C15 unless DANGLING rows are added, as task 616 did for the twisted-arrow anchors. Recorded for the planner.

lean_local_search returned index=error on first call and index=warming on the second; absence claims (no Conduche fibration in Mathlib) were therefore established by grep over .lake/packages/mathlib rather than by the LSP index.

The plan's full Lean Challenge Statements block (55 declarations across 8 proof phases, sorry-bodied) was compiled at plan time with lake env lean against the built tree and exits 0, so every pinned signature the implementer must honour is known to typecheck before implementation starts. One design correction surfaced by the compile: a bare def-valued Quiver on F.WorldState is not found by instance synthesis (Quiver.Path.length/nil/comp fail), so the plan carries the quiver on a synonym StepGraph F with an instance, mirroring PathCat — no instance leaks onto a cluster type.

Phase 1: the plan's three-step shape for glueSum_restrict_right (states_eq_of_eq + restrict_states rewrite + exact) failed at the rw step because restrict_glue_right's conclusion mentions glue (the unfolded form) while the goal mentions glueSum, so the rw pattern did not match syntactically; fixed inline by dropping the rewrite on the hypothesis and closing by exact, which works definitionally since glueSum unfolds to glue and castLen preserves .val. One build cycle lost.

Phase 1 commit refused by the pre-commit typst-sync-check gate: typst/generated/status.typ pins FormalSystem's .lean file count and line count, so adding Path.lean (and every later phase's growth of it) makes the committed stamp stale. The plan scheduled status.typ regeneration only for Phase 9; it is needed at every phase commit. Resolved by running scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix before each commit and staging status.typ explicitly (file was clean: sibling 782 had completed). The same gate also prints an advisory about FormalSystem.lean lacking the new import, which does not block and is deferred to Phase 9 as planned.

Phase 2: the plan prescribes Constraints-consumed markers 'Seriality, Limit' / 'Compositionality, Seriality, Limit' on declarations that carry an [F.IsRegular] binder (PathHom.id, id_len, id_comp, comp_id, and later the PathCat instance, len, and the D = Z declarations). check-module-invariants.sh C34a fails any such marker unless the body names a binder-free twin with the identical list, which these bodies cannot (Beh.ofGerm and F.comp carry the binder and no marker). Resolved by writing the exempt all-four list on every binder-carrying declaration and stating the actually-reached constraints in prose; plan items annotated as altered. The plan's own Phase 9 requires C34 to pass, so the gate wins over the marker text.

Phases 4 and 5 (fibration property, associated-presheaf equality): Phase 4's nine declarations compiled on the first build, and assocRestrict_sec closed by rfl exactly as the plan predicted, confirming the research report's R3/R4 encoding (length in the hom, .val-level comparisons, middle factor defined as the restriction). The plan-time Challenge-statement compile meant no statement needed adjusting across Phases 1-5.

Phase 7 (the plan's highest-risk phase, the Quiver.Path round trip's forward half) landed in three build cycles: toPath_id is rfl because Lean's K-like reduction of Eq.rec collapses the 0-case transport along w = w, toPath_length is a four-line induction, and toPath_comp needed only three local congruence lemmas plus one glue_unique argument. The anticipated dependent-equality cost was real but contained to the local congr_e/cons_congr helpers; no new top-level declaration was needed.

Phase 8: PathHom.ofStep and ofPath_toPath initially measured Classical.choice. Isolated by a probe file to Mathlib's order-theoretic not_le.mpr zero_lt_one and le_of_add_le_add_right on Z (each alone pulls choice on this Mathlib pin), not to the computable Int.decLe if-then-else. Replaced by decide, omega on a genuinely Z-typed binder, and the core Int.not_le/Int.le_antisymm; the whole module is now choice-free. Note: omega ignores hypotheses whose terms have the syntactic type F.toTaskFrame.Duration even though it is defeq to Z, so it only works on binders written as (i : Z).

Phase 9: check-module-invariants.sh C16 (Mathlib env linters) flagged the simpNF linter on the auto-generated BObj.mk.injEq, a one-field structure over Unit whose constructor-injectivity simp lemma simp proves outright. Resolved via the C26-sanctioned in-source route: attribute [nolint simpNF] BObj.mk.injEq with a reason comment plus the simpNF:BObj.mk.injEq row in scripts/nolint-attribute-allowlist.txt. The plan's Challenge block pinned BObj's shape, so the structure was kept rather than replaced by a nullary inductive.

Phase 9: the first full lake build after wiring Path.lean into the aggregator exceeded the 590 s foreground timeout (exit 124) because the Presheaf aggregator import fans out to the Metalogic/Decidability closure; the killed module's work was lost and the build was relaunched as a detached guarded job with the bounded kill -0 waiter, finishing green on the second call. Roughly ten minutes lost; the plan's Risks row anticipated the long build but phases 1-8 had trained a foreground habit on a cached tree.
